items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: I don't remember that, any part of that because I was too young at that time, see?

ctx.x: Did Emmett have much drive compared to Big Son? Yeah.

He, he had a drive and he didn't know how to get into a ride out course and play it that way, see? Mm-hmm. And, I mean, he just, he just played some wonderful notes like, like Big Son would play, you know? Mm-hmm. And, uh, I don't know how to, whether, whether, he went up to, to, to play with the New Orleans rhythm games. Mm-hmm. And, uh, and then, they finally come back home. I, I don't know whether, whether, whether Paul had left the band or was gonna leave the band or what, Paul Bares, you know? Yeah. And I,…

Well, Oscar was up there with him, Oscar Marco. Yeah. And, uh, he was, uh, he was, uh, a nice man. He told me a lot about that, said that, that they had both, uh, Emmett and Paul in the band. Oh, they did?
